typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp,
		WF_GUID as string,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CORRELATION_ID as string,
		SYS_CREATED_ON as timestamp,
		SHORT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		IP_ADDRESS as string,
		NAME as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_GROUP as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp,
		SYS_CREATED_BY as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY as string,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_GUID as string,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		short_description as string,
		operational_status_description as string,
		operational_status as string,
		operational_status_group as string,
		wf_guid as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ip_address as string,
		sys_updated_on as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		todsh_business_effective_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		sys_class_name as string,
		managed_by_group_guid as string,
		sys_updated_by as string,
		sys_created_on as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		managed_by_group_name as string,
		name as string,
		correlation_id as string,
		sys_class_description as string,
		sys_created_by as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		short_description = SHORT_DESCRIPTION,
		operational_status_description = OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION,
		operational_status = OPERATIONAL_STATUS,
		operational_status_group = OPERATIONAL_STATUS_GROUP,
		wf_guid = WF_GUID,
		importdate,
		ip_address = IP_ADDRESS,
		sys_updated_on = SYS_UPDATED_ON,
		todsh_business_effective_date = TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		sys_class_name = SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		managed_by_group_guid = MANAGED_BY_GROUP_GUID,
		sys_updated_by = SYS_UPDATED_BY,
		sys_created_on = SYS_CREATED_ON,
		managed_by_group_name = MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME,
		name = NAME,
		correlation_id = CORRELATION_ID,
		sys_class_description = SYS_CLASS_DESCRIPTION,
		sys_created_by = SYS_CREATED_BY),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
